mapper.select: SELECT fp.FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_TYPE, fp.FINPROD_TYPE2, fp.FINPROD_ABBR,fp.FINPROD_NAME, fp.PROFIT_TYPE, fp.COUPON_SPECIES,fp.CHL_FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.ISSUE_ID,fp.ISSUE_PRICE,fp.ISSUE_AMT, fp.CCY CCY, fp.BLN_AREA BLN_AREA, fp.TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET,fp.CALENDAR_ID, fp.ISSUE_TYPE, fp.OPERATION_TYPE, fp.ENTRUST_TYPE,fp.ENTRUSTER, fp.TRUSTEE_ID, fp.ISSUER, fp.MANAGER,fp.FINANCIER, fp.IDATE, fp.VDATE, fp.MDATE, fp.TERM_DAYS, fp.ACTMDATE, fp.LIQUIDATION_DATE,fp.IS_CHL,fp.IS_SUS, fp.SUSTAINABLE_REMARK, fp.IS_RIGHT,fp.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE, fp.P_FINPROD_ID,fp.O_FINPROD_ID, fp.REGIST_ORG, fp.EXE_DATE, fp.REMARK, fp.CREATE_USER,fp.CREATE_DEPT, fp.CREATE_TIME, fp.UPDATE_USER, fp.UPDATE_TIME,fp.CONTRACT_NO,fp.IS_FIN_ORG, fp.SPONSOR, fp.INVEST_ADVISER,fp.LIQUIDATION_YESNO FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpd ON fp.FINPROD_ID = fpd.FINPROD_ID WHERE fpd.IS_ISSUE_ASSET = #{YESORNO_Y} AND fpd.APPEAR_MARKET_ID IS NULL AND fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPRODTYPE2F01}

SELECT CASH_ID CASH_ID, CASH_TYPE_1 CASH_TYPE_1, CASH_TYPE_2 CASH_TYPE_2, CCY CCY, FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, BRANCH BRANCH, FEE_ID FEE_ID, CHL_FINPROD_ID CHL_FINPROD_ID, CHL_LEVEL CHL_LEVEL, IS_CALC IS_CALC, CREATE_USER CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME, COLLECT_TYPE COLLECT_TYPE FROM FIN_CASH_INFO WHERE FINPROD_ID =#{finprodId}

SELECT fccr.CASH_ID CASH_ID, fccr.EFF_DATE EFF_DATE, fccr.CALC_TYPE CALC_TYPE, fccr.BASE_TYPE BASE_TYPE, fccr.BASE_DATE_TYPE BASE_DATE_TYPE,fccr.BASIS BASIS, fccr.YIELD YIELD, fccr.IS_INITIAL IS_INITIAL, fccr.FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, fccr.FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE,fccr.FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, fccr.BRANCH BRANCH, fccr.REMARK REMARK, fccr.CREATE_USER CREATE_USER,fccr.CREATE_DEPT CREATE_DEPT, fccr.CREATE_TIME CREATE_TIME, fccr.UPDATE_USER UPDATE_USER, fccr.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr WHERE fccr.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/
AND fccr.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/

SELECT fri.CASH_ID, fri.EFF_DATE, fri.INT_TYPE, fri.BASIS, fri.RESET_TYPE, fri.RESET_FREQ, fri.FIRST_RESET_DATE, fri.RESET_DATE,fri.OBSERVE_BEF_DAY, fri.OBSERVE_BEF_UNIT, fri.RATE, fri.COEFFICIENT,fri.SPREAD_RATE,fri.HIGHEST_RATE, fri.LOWEST_RATE, fri.BENCHMARK_ID,fri.BENCHMARK_TYPE,fri.FINPROD_ID,fri.BRANCH, fri.FINPROD_TYPE,fri.FINPROD_TYPE2, fri.REMARK,fri.CREATE_USER, fri.CREATE_DEPT, fri.CREATE_TIME, fri.UPDATE_USER, fri.UPDATE_TIME, fri.FIRST_CONFIRM_DATE FROM FIN_RATE_INFO fri WHERE fri.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/
AND fri.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/

SELECT fcpr.CASH_ID, fcpr.EFF_DATE,fcpr.PAY_CYCLE_VAL, fcpr.PAY_CYCLE, fcpr.DAY_TYPE, fcpr.DAY_VALUE, fcpr.END_TDAY_RULE, fcpr.PAY_TDAY_RULE, fcpr.CALC_RULE, fcpr.FIRST_PAY_DATE, fcpr.CASH_UNIT_TYPE, fcpr.FINPROD_ID, fcpr.FINPROD_TYPE,fcpr.FINPROD_TYPE2, fcpr.BRANCH, fcpr.PAY_TYPE, fcpr.REMARK,fcpr.CREATE_USER, fcpr.CREATE_DEPT, fcpr.CREATE_TIME,fcpr.UPDATE_USER,fcpr.UPDATE_TIME,fcpr.PAY_MONTH FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE fcpr WHERE fcpr.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/
AND fcpr.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/

SELECT fcp.CASH_ID, fcp.MDATE, fcp.CASH_NUM, fcp.CASH_TYPE, fcp.VDATE_UNADJUST, fcp.MDATE_UNADJUST, fcp.PAY_DATE_UNADJUST, fcp.VDATE,fcp.PAY_DATE, fcp.TERMDAYS, fcp.VDATE_Y, fcp.VDATE_TERM, fcp.MDATE_TERM,fcp.TERMDAYS_TERM, fcp.PRIN_AMT,fcp.INT_PRIN_AMT, fcp.INT_AMT,fcp.IS_PAY_INT, fcp.CASH_AMT, fcp.CASH_BASEAMT, fcp.CASH_UNIT_TYPE, fcp.CALC_FUNCTION, fcp.FREQUENCY, fcp.FINPROD_ID, fcp.FINPROD_TYPE,fcp.FINPROD_TYPE2, fcp.BRANCH, fcp.PAY_TYPE PAY_TYPE, fcp.RANGE_YIELD,fcp.REMARK, fcp.CREATE_USER, fcp.CREATE_DEPT, fcp.CREATE_TIME,fcp.UPDATE_USER, fcp.UPDATE_TIME, fcp.REPAY_WITHOUT_INT FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp WHERE fcp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/
AND fcp.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/

SELECT fep.CASH_ID, fep.EXERCISE_TYPE, fep.EXERCISE_DATE, fep.VDATE VDATE, fep.MDATE, fep.EXERCISE_STATUS, fep.EXERCISE_PRICE, fep.EXERCISE_REMARK, fep.FINPROD_ID, fep.FINPROD_TYPE, fep.FINPROD_TYPE2, fep.BRANCH, fep.CREATE_USER, fep.CREATE_DEPT, fep.CREATE_TIME, fep.UPDATE_USER, fep.UPDATE_TIME, fep.ACT_EXERCISE_DATE FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN fep WHERE fep.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/
AND fep.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/

SELECT esp.PORTFOLIO_ID, esp.SEC_ACCT_ID, esp.FINPROD_ID, esp.BRANCH, esp.INV_AIM, esp.HODING_TYPE, esp.CDATE, esp.AMOUNT, esp.CCY, esp.P_FINPROD_ID, esp.FACE_VALUE, esp.CREATE_USER, esp.CREATE_DEPT, esp.CREATE_TIME, esp.UPDATE_USER, esp.UPDATE_TIME FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION esp WHERE esp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/ AND esp.CDATE = to_date(#{DealDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT esp.PORTFOLIO_ID, esp.SEC_ACCT_ID, esp.FINPROD_ID, esp.BRANCH, esp.INV_AIM, esp.HODING_TYPE, esp.CDATE, esp.AMOUNT, esp.CCY, esp.P_FINPROD_ID, esp.FACE_VALUE, esp.CREATE_USER, esp.CREATE_DEPT, esp.CREATE_TIME, esp.UPDATE_USER, esp.UPDATE_TIME FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION esp WHERE esp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/ AND esp.CDATE = to_date(#{DealDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
